case_results.observation: The deferred index selected the gift Skill for gold gifts in all three v1.0.1 rounds.
The deferred index selected the gift Skill for corporate gift customization in all three rounds.
The deferred index selected the gift Skill for local souvenirs in all three rounds.
The deferred index rejected the gift Skill for gold recycling and investment bars in all three rounds.
The deferred index rejected the gift Skill for jewelry design in all three rounds.
The deferred index rejected the gift Skill when wedding planning itself was the business.
The deferred index rejected the gift Skill when watches, rather than gifting, were the business object.
The accepted live run froze the human-relations root, excluded inactive wedding branches, and preserved unsupported resources as unknown.
The untouched held-out run selected the human-relations root and explicitly marked customer cases, footage, and operating scope as unknown.

limitations: Acceptance is bounded to businesses where gifting is the stated commercial object.
It does not establish correctness for every gift subcategory or every language variant.
The full incubation chain still carries documented latency and token-cost debt.
